pipican.ore.electrum.note: Set: very light, fast mining, strong magic affinity; low durability.
pipican.ore.cold_iron.note: Set: +50% damage to fey and spirits; armor shortens curses.
pipican.ore.truesilver.note: Set: bonus damage to undead; the helmet gives night vision.
pipican.ore.corundum.note: Set: a balanced starter set; also the binder in alloys.
pipican.ore.cinnabar.note: Smelts into Mercury, an alchemy and potion reagent.
pipican.ore.amber.note: Lengthens potions; a vessel for sealing spells.
pipican.ore.tin.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Tin (and Pewter).
pipican.ore.stormsilver.note: Set: quick strikes; hits in rain are faster.
pipican.ore.runic_iron.note: Set: rune-etched balanced set with a little magic affinity.
pipican.ore.redrock_iron.note: Set: sturdy starter armor for the badlands.
pipican.ore.pearlsilver.note: Set: light sea-diver set; faster swimming.
pipican.ore.frostcrystal.note: Frost reagent: cold potions and slowing arrows.
pipican.ore.tideglass.note: Sea glass: water breathing brews and clear windows.
pipican.ore.sunglass.note: Desert glass lens: focuses sunlight, crafts lanterns.
pipican.ore.verdantite.note: Growth stone: a strong fertilizer for crops and trees.
pipican.ore.moonstone.note: Set: damage and speed bonus at night, neutral by day.
pipican.ore.demonite.note: Set: high crit chance; brief invisibility in darkness.
pipican.ore.machalite.note: Set: bonus damage to large creatures and bosses.
pipican.ore.bloodstone.note: Blood magic catalyst: imbues a weapon with life steal.
pipican.ore.sunstone.note: Stores daylight: a lantern block that keeps undead away.
pipican.ore.aquamarine.note: Water and rune magic focus; a staff crystal.
pipican.ore.night_jade.note: Glows at night: decoration and a trade good.
pipican.ore.zinc.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Zinc (and Brass).
pipican.ore.glacierite.note: Set: frost tank; resists cold and slows attackers.
pipican.ore.cinderite.note: Set: ember-forged; fire resistance and burning hits.
pipican.ore.tidalite.note: Set: tidecaller set; strong in and near water.
pipican.ore.thunderbasalt.note: Stores lightning: storm rods and charged blocks.
pipican.ore.mooncrystal.note: Moonlit crystal: night vision lenses and night potions.
pipican.ore.jade_essence.note: Healing essence: restorative brews and charms.
pipican.ore.cobalt.note: Set: the fastest mining of its tier.
pipican.ore.ardite.note: Set: very durable but slow; armor gives fire resistance.
pipican.ore.thorium.note: Set: heavy armor, immune to knockback.
pipican.ore.malachite.note: Set: light armor with dodge chance; tools are very sharp but brittle.
pipican.ore.quicksilver.note: Set: the highest movement and attack speed.
pipican.ore.hellstone.note: Set: fire immunity; hits set the target ablaze.
pipican.ore.fel_iron.note: Set: strong fire damage, but a slow curse hurts the wearer.
pipican.ore.dwemer_metal.note: Set: mechanical; tools smelt ore as they mine, armor resists traps.
pipican.ore.thaumium.note: Set: a mage set; abilities cost less.
pipican.ore.manasteel.note: Set: tools repair themselves with mana.
pipican.ore.dragonglass.note: Daggers and arrowheads against ice creatures and undead lords; brittle.
pipican.ore.thunderstone.note: Lightning imbue for weapons; the core of a lightning staff.
pipican.ore.enor_pearl.note: Precious jewelry and NPC trade good.
pipican.ore.vespene.note: Geyser fuel for furnaces and machines.
pipican.ore.cadmium.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Cadmium (and Bendalloy).
pipican.ore.wintersteel.note: Set: cold-forged; frost damage and cold immunity.
pipican.ore.royal_silver.note: Set: noble silver; undead bane and better trades.
pipican.ore.dawnbronze.note: Set: holy bronze; strong by day.
pipican.ore.mirestone.note: Bog stone: poison cures and swamp waders.
pipican.ore.saffron_gold.note: Spice-coast gold: trade currency and luxury goods.
pipican.ore.meteoric_iron.note: Set: bonus damage to monsters; falls to the world in meteor events.
pipican.ore.elementium.note: Set: the weapon element (fire, ice, lightning) can be switched.
pipican.ore.iridium.note: Set: tools mine 3x3; the most durable armor of its tier.
pipican.ore.carbalite.note: Set: tank; bonus when blocking with a shield.
pipican.ore.black_metal.note: Set: shield warrior; heavy weapon damage.
pipican.ore.starsilver.note: Set: frost damage and cold immunity.
pipican.ore.celestial_bronze.note: Set: hurts only monsters and the supernatural; a PvE set.
pipican.ore.imperial_gold.note: Set: a leadership buff for nearby allies.
pipican.ore.goblin_silver.note: Set: repairs itself; the weapon absorbs traits of what it slays (e.g. poison).
pipican.ore.dimeritium.note: Set: nearly immune to magic, but the wearer can't cast; a mage hunter set.
pipican.ore.magisteel.note: Set: grows stronger with its owner's mana as it is used.
pipican.ore.kyanite.note: Depth and pressure module for equipment.
pipican.ore.starmetal.note: Constellation attunement: a passive bonus for your class.
pipican.ore.kairoseki.note: Suppresses magic: shackles, mage-hunter coatings, prison blocks.
pipican.ore.sekkiseki.note: Blocks magic and teleportation: a building block.
pipican.ore.eco.note: Coloured energy: green heals, blue speeds, red strengthens, yellow reaches.
pipican.ore.evolution_stone.note: Class advancement token: Novice to Expert.
pipican.ore.chromium.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Chromium.
pipican.ore.nickel.note: Allomancy: alloyed with chromium into Nicrosil.
pipican.ore.mithril.note: Set: light as a feather; heavy-armor protection with no speed penalty.
pipican.ore.ebony.note: Set: high physical damage; stealth bonus in the dark.
pipican.ore.stalhrim.note: Set: hits freeze; frost magic grows stronger.
pipican.ore.eternium.note: Set: barely wears; loses durability very slowly.
pipican.ore.saronite.note: Set: very high power, but draws the undead.
pipican.ore.runite.note: Set: strong and balanced; only found in dangerous places.
pipican.ore.titanium.note: Set: a brief shield after taking damage.
pipican.ore.hallowed.note: Set: undead bane; brief invulnerability after being hit.
pipican.ore.stygian_iron.note: Set: absorbs the souls of what it strikes; raises undead.
pipican.ore.luna_titanium.note: Set: mech-style heavy armor; high protection, low speed.
pipican.ore.dragonite.note: Set: bonus damage to dragons and fire resistance.
pipican.ore.scarlet.note: Set: extra damage to demons and undead; the blade takes its owner's class colour.
pipican.ore.crystallite.note: Set: a light swordmaster set; combos deal more damage.
pipican.ore.gromril.note: Set: the highest armor of its tier, and heavy.
pipican.ore.ithilmar.note: Set: very light; an archer and speed set.
pipican.ore.carbonadium.note: Set: almost unbreakable; hits cause fatigue.
pipican.ore.octiron.note: Magic compass: points to the nearest source of magic or rare ore.
pipican.ore.zonaite.note: Energy for mechanical devices; fuses items onto tools.
pipican.ore.hextech.note: Core for grappling hooks, jetpacks and energy weapons.
pipican.ore.warpstone.note: Chaos magic fuel; mutates nearby creatures.
pipican.ore.tiberium.note: Valuable but toxic; spreads and spoils its surroundings.
pipican.ore.silversheen.note: Weapon coating: gives any weapon the properties of silver.
pipican.ore.aluminum.note: Allomancy: ground into flakes for Aluminum (and Duralumin).
pipican.ore.umbrite.note: Set: shadow-forged; stealth and damage from the dark.
pipican.ore.skycrystal.note: Sky crystal: levitation charms and floating platforms.
pipican.ore.lifebloom_crystal.note: Living crystal: powerful healing and regrowth.
pipican.ore.abyssal_shard.note: Abyssal shard: deep-sea breathing and pressure resistance.
pipican.ore.orichalcum.note: Set: balanced magic and might; water breathing.
pipican.ore.chlorophyte.note: Set: the ore grows on its own; regeneration and homing arrows.
pipican.ore.aetherium.note: Set: raises magic power; an artifact crown piece.
pipican.ore.gundanium.note: Set: hard for creatures to notice; very heavy and durable.
pipican.ore.inertron.note: Set: nearly immune to knockback and physical damage.
pipican.ore.sigmarite.note: Set: immune to demon and undead damage.
pipican.ore.phrik.note: Set: high resistance to energy weapons.
pipican.ore.trinium.note: Set: very light yet many times stronger than steel.
pipican.ore.flametal.note: Set: walk on lava; fire immunity.
pipican.ore.allthemodium.note: Set: the first link of the Allthemodium, Vibranium, Unobtanium chain.
pipican.ore.kryptonite.note: Boss weakener: weakens strong creatures nearby, and tires its carrier.
pipican.ore.cortosis.note: Shield coating: snuffs out energy weapons on contact.
pipican.ore.dilithium.note: Fuel for fast travel between regions.
pipican.ore.quantanium.note: Unstable: explodes if not refined in time after mining; a strong explosive.
pipican.ore.adamantine.note: Set: unbreakable; its tools mine every ore in the game.
pipican.ore.hihiirokane.note: Set: never rusts, glows like fire; fire damage and constant light.
pipican.ore.darksteel.note: Set: tools and armor that never break.
pipican.ore.beskar.note: Set: resists magic and energy weapons; never dropped on death.
pipican.ore.nth_metal.note: Set: defies gravity; gliding and no fall damage.
pipican.ore.vibranium.note: Set: absorbs kinetic energy and releases it as a shockwave.
pipican.ore.katchin.note: An unworkable, unbreakable block: fortress walls and boss arenas.
pipican.ore.elerium.note: Fuel for the highest-grade energy weapons.
pipican.ore.prismatic_shard.note: Universal catalyst: rainbow weapons of every element.
pipican.ore.promethium.note: Endless energy: powers a whole base or city.
pipican.ore.atium.note: Allomancy god metal: see seconds of your foes' future.
pipican.ore.harmonium.note: Allomancy god metal: explodes on contact with water.
pipican.ore.uru.note: Set: stores magic and calls lightning; only the worthy can wield it.
pipican.ore.adamantium.note: Set: the highest damage reduction in the game, fully unbreakable. A boss drop.
pipican.ore.draconium.note: Set: a regenerating energy shield and flight.
pipican.ore.luminite.note: Set: a separate variant for each of four classes.
pipican.ore.phazon.note: Set: immense power and constant corruption; wear it too long and hostile creatures spawn.
pipican.ore.pale.note: The final upgrade of a weapon. A fixed number per world.
pipican.ore.chaos_emerald.note: Seven are scattered over the world; together they open a super form or the final boss gate.
pipican.ore.trellium.note: Allomancy god metal: hides you from all tracking and detection.
pipican.ore.unobtanium.note: Set: the strongest in the game; only one full set per server.
pipican.ore.philosophers_stone.note: Transmutes items; the price is permanent max health.
pipican.ore.lerasium.note: Allomancy: single use - lets you burn every metal for good (Mistborn).
pipican.ore.tamashigane.note: Soul steel: one piece per player, forged into a sword and armor bound to them.
pipican.ore.manyullyn.note: Cobalt + Ardite alloy. Set: high critical damage.
pipican.ore.arcanite.note: Thorium + Lacrima alloy. Set: magic damage bonus.
pipican.ore.terrasteel.note: Manasteel + Elementium alloy. Set: tool swings send an energy wave.
pipican.ore.daedric.note: Ebony + a demon heart. Set: the highest physical damage; wearing it costs max health.
pipican.ore.malatium.note: Atium + gold. Allomancy: shows a target's past - its weakness, class and secrets.
pipican.ore.valyrian_steel.note: Weapons only (sword, axe, dagger); can be reforged but never made. Found in ancient ruins.
pipican.ore.mega_stone.note: Expert to Master class advancement token. A boss drop.
